title: Shortest Distance After Road Addition Queries II
summary: Start with roads i to i+1 for 0 <= i < n-1. After each query adds a road u to v, return the shortest distance from city 0 to city n-1.
officialConstraints: 3 <= n <= 10^5 and 1 <= queries.length <= 10^5 (search summary). Query ordering u < v not confirmed.
examples: n = 4, queries [[0,3],[0,2]] -> [1,1] (search summary). Only this example is recorded.
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts n up to 12 and 12 queries. The Python reference recomputes distances from v onward per query: correct, but O(n * q), not the optimized official-limit solution.
